cost: base_order O(nlog n), moved O(nlog n) time/O(n) memory, order_ok O(nlog k); prealign delegates LCS O(nm) time/state. Reader scripts delegate matching costs. Text encode/decode O(tokens+literal bytes) plus ordered map insertion/lookup. Direct recursion adds one Words pass, never unbounded recursion.
description: reader_res converts MTok to nodes, prealigns lowercase lemmas by LCS plus equal-length gaps, encodes tree script and charges moved positions outside a strict LIS. reader_block concatenates verses with § sentinel and shifted nonzero heads, checks script apply and order_ok. Text encoding records noncanonical literal gaps and tail. Run::verse measures normal output separately, builds reader/encoder/stack residual, decodes with first-failure precedence meta-world→meta order→tree→tokens→text; direct mode recurses once with Words.

inverse: Gate success excludes any earlier detected unequal layer. Meta direct mode cannot recursively request another Meta direct pass. Text decode with a retained noncanonical gap cannot silently replace it with canonical spacing. No annotation/model executed in selected reader/text/order checks.

Given forms, space and RText, decode determines one text; removing RText admits all gap/tail variants. Script plus source reconstructs target nodes on admitted domain, but target alone has many sources/scripts. LIS complement may vary across optimal subsequences; this implementation selects deterministic lowest-tail replacement.
limitations: Source-derived effectful CLI/corpus paths only; no live model/annotator/training/filesystem/site run.
Finite synthetic helper checks and partial syntax; no universal proof or executable percent surrogate.
state: Trees have valid heads and aligned forms/gaps; base is permutation1..n, moved sorted distinct subset. choose_bits requires0<=k<=n; offsets/counts fit usize/i64. Finite residual arithmetic. Exact gate concerns target reproduction using residual, not residual-free translation correctness or learning.
